Functional description

The connection for the radiotaxi D57 receives a direct supply from the battery via the line for the specific fuse B57 and is suitably earthed.

The connection for the taxi-meter D55 receives a direct supply from the battery - pin 6 - via the line for the specific fuse B55 and the maxifuse J/B2 of B5 .and is suitably earthed.

It receives a supply controlled by the ignition (INT) (pin 7) via the line for fuse F1 of the junction unit B1 .

Pin 2 receives a supply, with the side lights on, via the line protected by fuse F2 of the junction unit B1 ( E2010 ).

Pin 5 of connection D55 is earthed.

Pin 1 receives the speedometer signal from the instrument panel E50 - pin 11 of connector C.

Pin 3 of D55 sends a supply, with the side lights on, to the connection for the TAXI sign D56 , which is suitably earthed.
